Let the sea carry it to another lonely soul, he thought, watching the beam sweep across the endless waves.", "w02": "凌晨四点，城市还在沉睡。路灯昏黄，照着空荡的街道，偶尔一辆出租车驶过，留下短暂的声响。早餐铺的灯刚刚亮起，蒸笼冒出白雾。扫街的工人默默推着车，环卫的扫帚声轻轻响起。写字楼一片漆黑，只有便利店透出冷白的光。天边泛起一丝微蓝，夜与昼在此刻交接。城市在呼吸，等待着又一个黎明的到来。", "w03": "- Recursion is when something solves a problem by using a smaller copy of itself.\n- Like standing between two mirrors, each picture holds a tinier picture inside it.\n- It keeps going until the problem is so small the answer is obvious, then it stops."}
